name: ptee-calico-networkpolicy-order
title: Calico NetworkPolicy: a real Deny and an order field
summary: The namespaced Calico NetworkPolicy looks like a KNP but adds the two things KNP lacked: an explicit Deny action and a spec.order that ranks policies. See it cooperate with a plain Kubernetes NetworkPolicy - which Calico ranks at order 1000 - in the same namespace.
